description: This file provides functions for image description using AI models, including resolving model runtime, building context, and handling image description requests with support for fallback models and external API integrations.

methods.name: loadPiModelDiscoveryRuntime
methods.description: Lazily loads the model discovery runtime module.

methods.name: resolveImageToolMaxTokens
methods.description: Determines the maximum tokens for image tools, respecting model limits.

methods.name: resolveImageRuntime
methods.description: Resolves the runtime environment for image description, including API key and model info.

methods.name: buildImageContext
methods.description: Builds a conversational context for image description prompts.

methods.name: describeImagesWithMinimax
methods.description: Uses the minimax model to describe multiple images.

methods.name: isUnknownModelError
methods.description: Checks if an error indicates an unknown model.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredProviderBaseUrl
methods.description: Resolves the base URL for a provider from configuration.

methods.name: resolveMinimaxVlmFallbackRuntime
methods.description: Resolves fallback runtime info for minimax VLM models.

methods.name: describeImagesWithModel
methods.description: Main function to describe images with a specified model, handling fallback and context.

methods.name: describeImageWithModel
methods.description: Wrapper to describe a single image with a specified model.
